nfrs.requirement: The DCR endpoint and Well-Known endpoint must be available 99.5% of the time per calendar month. Sustained underperformance triggers FCA supervisory engagement under CMA Open Banking Order.
DCR POST /register response within 2 seconds P95. Well-Known endpoint response within 200ms P99.
nfrs.target: P95 < 2s for DCR; P99 < 200ms for Well-Known

nfrs.requirement: POST /domestic-payment-consents must be available 99.5% of the time per calendar month (OBIE ASPSP API availability obligation).
POST /domestic-payment-consents synchronous call chain (SVC-017 → SVC-001) must respond within 1 second P95.
TPP client credentials validated on every API call. SSA signature verified against OBIE Directory public key at PH-035 registration and re-verified daily via last_validated_at.
nfrs.target: Zero tolerance for invalid credential acceptance

nfrs.requirement: SVC-100 (IAM — SCA) must be available as a dependency. SCA failures degrade to a fallback SCA method (e.g. SMS OTP if biometric unavailable). Complete unavailability of SCA blocks PH-037 — this is a designated important business service (IBS) failure event requiring FCA notification if sustained beyond impact tolerance.
nfrs.target: SCA success rate > 99% under normal conditions

nfrs.requirement: Consent screen load time < 2 seconds P95. SCA verification round-trip (push notification to customer biometric to SVC-100 confirmation) < 10 seconds P90.
nfrs.target: Screen load P95 < 2s; SCA round-trip P90 < 10s

nfrs.requirement: Dynamic linking must bind the SCA authentication to the specific payment_amount and payee_account_details displayed to the customer. Any mismatch between consent details and SCA challenge is a mandatory rejection.
nfrs.target: 100% compliance with PSD2 RTS Article 97 dynamic linking

nfrs.requirement: Consent confirmation screen must meet WCAG 2.1 AA. Payment details (amount, payee, reference) must be displayed at minimum font size 16px with sufficient colour contrast. Consumer Duty — Understanding outcome.
POST /domestic-payments synchronous response (SVC-017 → SVC-001 → HTTP 201 back to TPP) must complete within 2 seconds P95. SVC-001 must create ENT-008 and publish EVT-P01 within this window.

POST /domestic-payments must be idempotent on consent_id. Duplicate requests with the same consent_id (e.g. TPP retry on timeout) must not create a second PaymentIntent. SVC-001 must detect and return the existing payment_id if ENT-030.status = consumed.
nfrs.target: Zero duplicate payments from retry on the same consent

nfrs.requirement: Access token validated against SVC-100 introspection endpoint on every POST /domestic-payments call. Token must be bound to the presented consent_id and scoped to 'payments'. Replay attacks prevented by token expiry (max 5 minutes for payment initiation tokens).

Sanctions screening (SVC-051 EVT-P02) must complete within 2 seconds P99. Fraud scoring (SVC-013 EVT-P03) must complete within 500ms P99. FPS submission by SVC-009 after PaymentCleared must occur within 5 seconds P99. Total time from EVT-P01 published to EVT-P05 published: < 30 seconds P99 (normal path).
nfrs.target: Sanctions P99 < 2s; Fraud P99 < 500ms; FPS P99 < 5s from PaymentCleared

nfrs.requirement: EVT-P01, EVT-P04, EVT-P05 events must be delivered with at-least-once semantics. All event consumers must be idempotent on payment_intent_id. Dead-letter queues must capture events that fail processing after 3 retries.
nfrs.target: Zero event loss; idempotent processing across all consumers

nfrs.requirement: fraud_score and fraud_risk_level in ENT-008 must not be surfaced to PER-006 (TPP) or PER-001 via any API response or notification. OBIE error codes for fraud/sanctions failures must use generic codes (UK.OBIE.Rules.FailedRiskRules).
nfrs.target: Zero disclosure of fraud or sanctions detail externally

nfrs.requirement: GET /domestic-payments/{id} response must be < 500ms P95. Status cache in SVC-017 updated within 2 seconds of EVT-062 or EVT-063 being published.

TPP polling rate must be rate-limited to max 10 GET requests per payment_id per minute. Excess requests return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header. This prevents unnecessary load from poorly-implemented TPP polling loops.

cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: All events (EVT-058 through EVT-063) must be routed to the WORM audit pipeline via SVC-103. Retention: 7 years (PSR 2017 record-keeping obligation). ENT-030 and ENT-031 records must be retained for 7 years from the consent creation date regardless of status.

Personal data in ENT-030 (customer_id, account_id, payee details) is processed under UK GDPR Article 6(1)(b) (contract performance) and Article 6(1)(c) (PSR 2017 compliance obligation). Payee sort code and account number are masked in log output (last 2 digits only). Customer-facing notifications must not include payee account number in full.

The Open Banking payment initiation path (PH-036 through PH-040) is designated as part of the Digital Channels important business service (IBS). Sustained unavailability above the board-approved impact tolerance is a notifiable event to FCA. Fallback interface (per GOV-006-R01 ASPSP obligations) must be available if the primary API is unavailable.

All Open Banking API traffic must use TLS 1.2 minimum (TLS 1.3 preferred). Mutual TLS (mTLS) required for all TPP-to-bank API calls using OBIE-issued transport certificates. OBIE-signed request objects (JAR) required for all authorisation requests. JWS signing of OBIE API response payloads required per OBIE Security Profile.

PER-001 must be able to view and revoke all active Open Banking consents via a consent dashboard in the bank's mobile/online banking. Consent dashboard must be available 99.5% of the time. Revocation via dashboard must set ENT-030.status = revoked within 60 seconds and publish EVT-060.

regulatory_slas.regulation: PSR 2017 / OBIE Standards — ASPSP API Availability
regulatory_slas.sla: 99.5% monthly availability for all OBIE-mandated endpoints
regulatory_slas.measurement: Measured per calendar month across all OBIE API endpoints. Availability excludes planned maintenance windows notified 1 week in advance to Open Banking Ltd.
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Sustained underperformance triggers FCA supervisory engagement and CMA reporting obligation. Published quarterly on Open Banking Ltd performance dashboard.

regulatory_slas.sla: Open banking FPS payments must be executed within the next business day at the latest. In practice, FPS provides immediate settlement — SVC-009 must submit within 5 seconds of EVT-P04.
regulatory_slas.measurement: Time from EVT-P01 to EVT-P05 publication
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Late execution is a PSR 2017 breach; customer entitled to refund of charges. Reported in PSR annual payment statistics.

regulatory_slas.sla: Maximum tolerable downtime (MTD) for the Open Banking payment initiation important business service set by the board and tested annually.
regulatory_slas.measurement: Continuous uptime monitoring. Material outage (above MTD) notified to FCA within 4 hours (initial) and 24 hours (full report).
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: FCA supervisory action. Customer communication obligation during sustained breach.
